objects.fact: One solid dark disk near the shared center, with one plus sign immediately to its upper-right. No constituent proton/neutron dots or count.
One smaller unfilled circular outline centered on the nucleus.
One larger unfilled circular outline sharing the same center.
Two small unfilled circle markers on the inner ring: upper-left and lower-right. Each has exactly one nearby minus sign.
Five small unfilled circle markers on the outer ring: upper-left, upper-right-of-top, right, lower-right and lower-left. Each has exactly one nearby minus sign.

relationships: Both ring outlines share the same nucleus-centered frame; do not split them into separate panels.
Each of the seven unfilled electron markers lies on its corresponding ring.
The plus sign belongs to the central nucleus; each minus belongs to one electron marker.
Approximate source positions and angular order are preserved without claiming a physical length, angle or electron trajectory.
notPresent: No nucleus constituent count, element name, atomic number, mass number or calibrated charge magnitude.
No orbital arrows, direction of motion, photons, bonds or second atom.
No point names, ring numbers, radius or energy-axis labels.
modernAdditions: Geometric circles and markers may be regularized into crisp deterministic shapes; this is not a measured source radius.
